decision: Approve design as a versioned local adaptation; implementation and measurements of all 15 tasks are pending.
finding: The source policy analysis names normal operating status inside an anomaly event positive_healthy support. This is not healthy exposure for the PDM false-alarm budget. Task 53 has its entire original prediction period inside the event.

policy.scope: All 15 Farm B tasks; no label-dependent selection or selective prefix extension.
policy.eval_prefix: [source_prediction_start - 7 days, source_prediction_start), on a fixed 600-second grid. Hold this source train tail out of fit, threshold, feature and window selection.
policy.fit_selection: Longest finite, status 0/2 segment with exact 600-second spacing ending at or before cutoff; earliest segment wins ties.
policy.sliding_window: Existing autocorrelation algorithm, bounded to 10–100 samples, applied only to the exact selected contiguous fit segment.
policy.nominal_prefix_labels: Normal based on the source train role and status 0/2; this does not claim all training data are free of faults.
policy.masking: Mask absent rows, missing selected values and status 1/3/4/5. Use fit-only medians as finite placeholders; preserve observed zeros and do not forward-fill status.
policy.events: Preserve source event timestamps and all original prediction rows; only indices shift after the prefix.
policy.healthy_requirement: All 15 tasks must have positive unmasked healthy exposure and sufficient contiguous fit data; otherwise fail closed.

next_required_proof: Materialize all 15 source tasks and measure new fit lengths and healthy reference exposure.
Check original, added and missing counts and index/time boundary consistency.
Measure serialized Arrow byte caps and bounded process memory.
Confirm changes to labels, prefix and prediction values do not change fit, features or window selection.
Keep labels, masks and task maps in Scorer; verify they do not enter research contexts or the development manifest.
limits: No loader, Arrow, registration or scoring acceptance yet.
The original source audit is preserved; this local policy is not equivalent to the published benchmark.
Farm C payloads must remain unopened.
